Solicitor fined for breaching the Accounts Rules

Published 8 October 2026

A tribunal has fined a solicitor, Mr J. Example of Example and Co, 15,000 pounds for breaches of the Accounts Rules. The tribunal found that he used money from the client account to pay office costs on four occasions in 2024.

Mr Example admitted the breaches. He was also ordered to pay costs of 6,200 pounds. The firm has since closed.

This is an enforcement decision about one individual. It does not change any rule.

Northbridge Legal Standards Authority. Test page, not a real regulator.
